'''2008 Worlds Team Bobby Hilburn DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Bobby Hilburn]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Team Tournament). Sheet title Fea Duh! Sheet spelling Hilbun normalized to Hilburn from header inventory.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Bobby Hilburn]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|Set Your Course For Alderaan]]
* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
